title: Abanyanisekileyo baseMakkah
intro: Kwimihla yokuqala yesityhilelo, xa isigidimi senyaniso sasijongene nenkcaso eqatha, imiphefumlo ethile yema ingenakushukunyiswa kwinkolelo yayo. La makholwa ajongene nenkohlakalo engenakucingelwa ngabo babefuna ukucima ukukhanya kokholo. Intlungu yabo yayinzima, ukubandezeleka kwabo kwakukukhulu—kodwa iilwimi zabo azizange ziyeke ukuvakalisa ubunye buka-Allah. Nokuba baphoswa ezinzulwini zokuphelelwa lithemba, ukhuselo lukaThixo lwabangqongile, luguqula uvavanyo lwabo lwaba bubungqina bokholo olungunaphakade. Makhe sihlolisise uhambo lwale miphefumlo imangalisayo.
clues: Savavanywa ngesohlwayo esiqatha ngenxa yokwala ukulahla ukholo lwethu kuThixo omnye
Abantu bethu babengenakukwazi ukusiphula isigqibo sethu, nokuba uburhalarhume babo babunokuba nobuchule kangakanani na
Sasixhonywa emthonjeni emini, kodwa uncedo lukaThixo lwalusoloko lukufuphi
Ukuqina kwethu kwabamangalisa kwanabo bakubonayo ukunyamezela kwethu
Abaninzi eMakkah bazama ukusinyanzela ukuba sirhoxe, kodwa sahlala siqinile
Xa konke kwakubonakala ngathi kulahlekile, inkululeko yethu yafika ngokungenelela okumangalisayo kukaThixo.
